scope: Six exact native predicate guidance successors; original signed ROWS and base hashes unchanged.

changes.description: Checks public API authorized CIDRs for a restricted address union. Empty ranges or rules covering the Internet fail; malformed ranges remain unresolved. Azure’s special outbound-IP selector is preserved.
changes.pass_when: The authorized IP ranges are valid and their union does not allow every source.
changes.fail_when: Authorized ranges are empty or their union allows every source.

caveats: An authorized-range declaration does not prove packet reachability. A universal CIDR or combined address-space coverage is unrestricted.

changes.description: Resolves the explicit TLS minimum or recognized predefined policy. If no explicit policy exists, uses the returned default policy name; missing or unknown defaults remain unresolved.
changes.pass_when: The explicit or native reported default policy requires TLS1.2 or newer.
changes.fail_when: The explicit or native reported default policy permits TLS1.0 or TLS1.1.

caveats: An omitted explicit policy is not enough: the native default policy must be known. No TLS handshake was performed.

changes.description: Checks enabled inline WAF configuration or resolves the gateway’s attached WAF policy and its enabled state. A policy reference alone is insufficient; missing or ambiguous policy evidence remains unresolved.
changes.pass_when: Inline WAF is enabled or the exact attached policy resolves to an enabled native policy.
changes.fail_when: Complete native configuration has no WAF declaration or the resolved protection is disabled.

caveats: Enabled configuration does not establish listener coverage or effective request blocking. Missing or ambiguous attached-policy evidence remains unresolved.

changes.description: Checks for enabled NSG or VNet flow logging with Traffic Analytics enabled and a workspace reference. Each target must resolve in the selected subscription’s network inventory.
changes.pass_when: An enabled matching flow log has enabled Traffic Analytics and a workspace reference.
changes.fail_when: Complete applicable network and flow inventories contain no such enabled configuration.

caveats: A workspace reference alone is insufficient. Both collection flags must be enabled; configuration does not prove log ingestion or delivery.

changes.description: Checks for enabled VNet flow logging with Traffic Analytics enabled and a workspace reference. Each target must resolve in the selected subscription’s network inventory.
changes.pass_when: An enabled matching VNet flow log has enabled Traffic Analytics and a workspace reference.
changes.fail_when: Complete applicable network and flow inventories contain no such enabled configuration.

caveats: A workspace reference alone is insufficient. Both collection flags must be enabled; configuration does not prove log ingestion or delivery.

changes.description: Checks the latest completed database vulnerability scan’s failed-check count. Execution errors, missing completion state or contradictory counts remain unresolved; an unexecuted scan with zero findings cannot pass.
changes.pass_when: The latest scan completed with Passed state and zero failed security checks.
changes.fail_when: The latest scan completed with Failed state and a positive failed-check count.

caveats: Only a completed scan with consistent status and counts is decisive. A failed execution or zero-count placeholder is not a clean assessment.
